name: FlashBlade - identify LED (day 2)
description: An operator asks for the identify LED on a hardware component to be lit or cleared, for example before a field engineer swaps a blade or a flash module. A human approves it, the LED is set through the FlashBlade collection and the outcome is logged with the AAP job link. A component without an identify LED is reported, not retried; a rejection is logged and changes nothing.

component.title: Component
component.description: Hardware component name as the array lists it under /hardware, for example CH1.FB1, CH1.FM1 or CH1.FB1.ETH1

led_state.title: Identify LED
led_state.description: on lights the identify LED, off clears it

parameters.prompt: Set the identify LED ${trigger.led_state} on ${trigger.component} of ${trigger.array}. The LED is a visual marker for whoever stands at the chassis; nothing else on the array changes, and a component without an identify LED is reported, not retried.

extra_vars.component_details: identify LED ${trigger.led_state} requested through the orchestrator (FlashBlade - identify LED (day 2))

extra_vars.subject: Identify LED ${identify_led.artifacts.led_state} on ${trigger.array} ${identify_led.artifacts.component}
extra_vars.detail: Requested through the orchestrator; the hardware record in the alert log says whether the LED changed and names a component without an identify LED. AAP job: ${identify_led.job_url}

extra_vars.subject: Identify LED ${trigger.led_state} on ${trigger.array} ${trigger.component} rejected or expired; nothing changed
extra_vars.detail: The approval was rejected or timed out after 24 hours. Raise a new request if the LED is still wanted.
